title: AXIOM Gap-Fill

canonical_node.axiom: Framework strengthening must preserve real structure while flagging drift and overclaims.
definitions: Redemption Operator: identity-preserving transformation through an optimization landscape with grace as the schedule.
Righteousness Ledger Operator: total moral account integrity; no transaction disappears.
W Control Operator: observer-side control parameter modulating coupling to law structure.
Trinity Functional Schema: Father=source/potential/field, Son=pattern/law/Logos, Spirit=actualization/reception/motion.
derivation: Redemption as simulated annealing: P(E,T)=exp(-E/(k_B T)), T(t)=T0/ln(e+t) (domain-fixed).
Righteousness as ledger: Assets = Liabilities + Equity; S_moral,before + S_action = S_moral,after.
W as optimal control: g_eff = g(1-W), W(t)=argmin_W J[g(1-W), S_moral, G_ext, F_c].
Trinity triads as functional analogy across laws.
canonical_node.action: Adopt the seven useful beams with required fixes; flag the three cracked beams; use neutral law labels until numbering conflict is resolved.
boundary: Does not claim accounting identity proves moral conservation.
Does not use T0/ln(1+t) without domain fix.
Does not claim '18 dependent variables traced' as written.
test: Check that all law-number references use neutral labels.
Check that dependent-variable count is corrected to split categories.
Check that annealing schedule uses T0/ln(e+t).
Check that accounting statements say 'models ledger integrity' not 'proves conservation'.

dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides formal operators for redemption, righteousness, and will as control parameter, plus a functional Trinity schema.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing law stack structure and the honesty rule.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this gap-fill, the framework lacks formal equations for redemption, righteousness, and will control.

classification.recommended_atom_action: Adopt with flags and required fixes

overstatement_risks: Law-number drift could cause misalignment with canon.
Accounting/Noether overstatement could imply proof where none exists.
Annealing schedule singularity could invalidate model.
kill_conditions: If law-number conflict is not resolved, cannot be cited as canon.
If dependent-variable count is not corrected, cannot claim trace.
If accounting is presented as proof, must be rejected.
If annealing schedule is used without fix, model is invalid.
risk.lean_target: Keep the seven useful beams with fixes; flag the three cracked beams.

plain_summary: This document is a provisional gap-fill that offers useful formal models for redemption, righteousness, and will, but has law-number drift, count errors, and mathematical overclaims. It should be adopted with flags and fixes, not as final canon.
